0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz, and Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle) while GG Jackson (ankle) and Jerami Grant (soreness) are day-to-day game-time decisions. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot), and Blake Hinson (hamstring), Kyle Filipowski (back) and Trey Alexander (knee) are also day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with Utah winning the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win.
